title: NormalizedSecurityEvent
description: Canonical normalized security event schema for NomaanOS Sentinel threat detection and investigation.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the event (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the security event schema.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization UUID. Nullable during raw initial staging, required for workspace-scoped records.

source_type.description: Origin category of the source log telemetry.

source_host.description: Hostname or FQDN where the event was logged.

event_type.description: Normalized category of the security event.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp when the original event occurred on the source system.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when NomaanOS Sentinel observed or received the log.

source_ip.description: Originating IPv4 or IPv6 address if applicable.

source_port.description: Originating TCP/UDP port number if known.

process_name.description: Daemon or process name generating the log record (e.g., sshd, sudo, systemd-logind).

message.description: Bounded summary or raw message text.

evidence.description: Structured JSON payload capturing rule evidence, raw line references, and matched fields.

ingestion_source.description: Mechanism through which the event was ingested.

integration_id.description: Optional integration UUID associating the event with an enrolled host asset.
